item.title: Associate professor: SELECTION PROCESS FOR THE RECRUITMENT OF A SECOND-LEVEL PROFESSOR – DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC GROUP: 01/INFO-01 COMPUTER SCIENCE, DISCIPLINARY SCIENTIFIC SECTOR: INFO-01/A COMPUTER SCIENCE. (Telemat. G.FORTUNATO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 12:00
Institution: Telemat. G.FORTUNATO, Benevento
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

University teaching experience (Italian/foreign) is required, preferably in e-learning at telematic universities. Structured online course management (video lectures, e-tivities, LMS, monitoring, tutoring, and e-learning training; videoconferencing alone is insufficient) for GSD 01/INFO-01 (Computer Science) in e-learning/blended modes is valued. Strong scientific expertise in Artificial Intelligence is required, specifically Reinforcement Learning algorithms (Deep, Multi-Agent, Inverse) for decision-making in complex environments and applications in digital health, smart environments, and communications. Evaluated: continuous international scientific output, participation and coordination…
